items.quote: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark
items.claim: God recalled Noah and the animals preserved in the ark
items.object: Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle

items.quote: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged
items.claim: God caused wind to blow over the earth, causing floodwaters to subside

items.quote: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained
items.claim: Sources of floodwaters—subterranean fountains and rain—were shut off
items.object: fountains of the deep, windows of heaven, rain

items.quote: And the waters returned from off the earth continually
items.claim: Floodwaters continuously withdrew from the land

items.quote: and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated
items.claim: After 150 days had elapsed, the floodwaters diminished
